stem.en: A nursing unit is redesigning its staff schedule. For each team statement, classify the conflict behavior as constructive and task-focused or destructive and relationship-focused.
stem.zh: 一个护理单元正在重新设计人员排班。请将每条团队陈述分类为“建设性、聚焦任务的冲突”或“破坏性、聚焦人际关系的冲突”。

rows.en: ‘Last quarter, 18% of evening shifts needed last-minute coverage. Can we compare how each proposal addresses that gap?’
rows.zh: “上季度有18%的晚班需要临时补人。我们能否比较每个方案如何解决这个缺口？”

rows.en: ‘Our shared goal is reliable coverage with a fair weekend rotation.’
rows.zh: “我们的共同目标是在公平轮转周末班的同时确保可靠覆盖。”

rows.en: ‘What concern do you have about rotating every third weekend?’
rows.zh: “你对每三个周末轮一次班有什么顾虑？”

rows.en: ‘Let us pilot the two schedules for four weeks and compare uncovered shifts and overtime.’
rows.zh: “我们可以分别试行这两种排班四周，再比较缺班和加班情况。”

rows.en: ‘You oppose this only because you hate change.’
rows.zh: “你反对这个方案只是因为你讨厌改变。”

rows.en: ‘Anyone competent could see that your schedule is a bad idea.’
rows.zh: “任何有能力的人都能看出你的排班方案很糟糕。”

rows.en: ‘I already asked the night staff to vote against Jordan's proposal.’
rows.zh: “我已经让夜班员工一起投票反对Jordan的方案。”

rows.en: ‘I will not discuss data presented by someone who never works hard.’
rows.zh: “我不会讨论一个从不努力工作的人提供的数据。”

columns.zh: 建设性、聚焦任务的冲突
破坏性、聚焦人际关系的冲突

correct.en: Constructive task conflict uses observable information, shared goals, curiosity, and testable solutions. Destructive relationship conflict attacks motives or competence, organizes opposition against a person, or refuses evidence-based discussion.
correct.zh: 建设性的任务冲突使用可观察的信息、共同目标、好奇提问和可检验的解决方案。破坏性的人际关系冲突会攻击动机或能力、拉拢他人反对某个人，或拒绝基于证据的讨论。

byChoice.en: This statement uses observable scheduling data and asks for comparison of solutions.
byChoice.zh: 该陈述使用可观察的排班数据，并要求比较解决方案。

byChoice.en: Naming the shared operational goal keeps disagreement focused on the work.
byChoice.zh: 明确共同的运营目标，使分歧继续聚焦于工作本身。

byChoice.en: Asking for the other person's concern invites perspective rather than assigning blame.
byChoice.zh: 询问对方的顾虑是在了解观点，而不是归咎责任。

byChoice.en: A time-limited pilot with measurable outcomes is a testable solution.
byChoice.zh: 有时间限制并可测量结果的试行方案属于可检验的解决办法。

byChoice.en: This labels the other person's motive instead of addressing the scheduling proposal.
byChoice.zh: 该陈述给对方的动机贴标签，而不是讨论排班方案。

byChoice.en: Attacking competence turns the disagreement into relationship conflict.
byChoice.zh: 攻击能力把工作分歧变成了人际关系冲突。

byChoice.en: Recruiting allies against a person escalates division rather than examining the proposal.
byChoice.zh: 拉拢同盟反对某个人会加剧分裂，而不是评估方案。

byChoice.en: Refusing to discuss evidence because of a personal judgment is destructive relationship conflict.
byChoice.zh: 因对个人的评价而拒绝讨论证据，属于破坏性的人际关系冲突。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for language about data, goals, questions, and experiments versus language that attacks the person or motive.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 寻找关于数据、目标、提问和试验的语言，并与攻击个人或动机的语言区分开。

glossary.defZh: 围绕工作内容、流程或方案本身的分歧。
围绕个人特质、动机或身份的对抗。
能够通过试行和可测量结果来评价的方案。

sourceMetadata: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS, Managing Conflict tool, task-focused conflict and constructive conflict-management behaviors, https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/mutual/tools/conflict.html

rows.zh: “任何有能力的人都能看出你的排班方案很糟糕。”

rows.en: ‘I already asked the night staff to vote against Jordan's proposal.’
rows.zh: “我已经让夜班员工一起投票反对Jordan的方案。”

rows.en: ‘I will not discuss data presented by someone who never works hard.’
rows.zh: “我不会讨论一个从不努力工作的人提供的数据。”

columns.zh: 建设性、聚焦任务的冲突
破坏性、聚焦人际关系的冲突

correct.en: Constructive task conflict uses observable information, shared goals, curiosity, and testable solutions. Destructive relationship conflict attacks motives or competence, organizes opposition against a person, or refuses evidence-based discussion.
correct.zh: 建设性的任务冲突使用可观察的信息、共同目标、好奇提问和可检验的解决方案。破坏性的人际关系冲突会攻击动机或能力、拉拢他人反对某个人，或拒绝基于证据的讨论。

byChoice.en: This statement uses observable scheduling data and asks for comparison of solutions.
byChoice.zh: 该陈述使用可观察的排班数据，并要求比较解决方案。

byChoice.en: Naming the shared operational goal keeps disagreement focused on the work.
byChoice.zh: 明确共同的运营目标，使分歧继续聚焦于工作本身。

byChoice.en: Asking for the other person's concern invites perspective rather than assigning blame.
byChoice.zh: 询问对方的顾虑是在了解观点，而不是归咎责任。

byChoice.en: A time-limited pilot with measurable outcomes is a testable solution.
byChoice.zh: 有时间限制并可测量结果的试行方案属于可检验的解决办法。

byChoice.en: This labels the other person's motive instead of addressing the scheduling proposal.
byChoice.zh: 该陈述给对方的动机贴标签，而不是讨论排班方案。

byChoice.en: Attacking competence turns the disagreement into relationship conflict.
byChoice.zh: 攻击能力把工作分歧变成了人际关系冲突。

byChoice.en: Recruiting allies against a person escalates division rather than examining the proposal.
byChoice.zh: 拉拢同盟反对某个人会加剧分裂，而不是评估方案。

byChoice.en: Refusing to discuss evidence because of a personal judgment is destructive relationship conflict.
byChoice.zh: 因对个人的评价而拒绝讨论证据，属于破坏性的人际关系冲突。

testTakingStrategy.en: Look for language about data, goals, questions, and experiments versus language that attacks the person or motive.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 寻找关于数据、目标、提问和试验的语言，并与攻击个人或动机的语言区分开。

glossary.defZh: 围绕工作内容、流程或方案本身的分歧。
围绕个人特质、动机或身份的对抗。
能够通过试行和可测量结果来评价的方案。

meta.source: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS, Managing Conflict tool, task-focused conflict and constructive conflict-management behaviors, https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/mutual/tools/conflict.html

stem.en: A secure text thread between two disciplines has become sarcastic and ambiguous. No urgent client danger is present. The facility repair sequence is: pause the escalating asynchronous exchange; move to a brief synchronous huddle; each person states the concern and relevant facts while the other confirms understanding; agree on one plan, owner, and deadline; then send a concise closed-loop written summary. Place the actions in the required order.
stem.zh: 两个专业团队之间的安全短信对话已经变得讽刺且含糊。目前没有紧急患者危险。机构规定的修复顺序是：暂停不断升级的异步交流；转为简短的同步碰头会；双方分别陈述问题和相关事实，同时由对方确认理解；共同确定一个计划、负责人和截止时间；最后发送简明的闭环书面总结。请按要求排序。

options.en: Each person states the concern and relevant facts; the other person confirms what was understood.
options.zh: 双方分别陈述问题和相关事实；另一方确认自己所理解的内容。

options.en: Send a concise written summary that closes the loop.
options.zh: 发送简明的书面总结，完成闭环沟通。

options.en: Move the discussion to a brief synchronous huddle.
options.zh: 将讨论转为简短的同步碰头会。

options.en: Agree on one plan, the responsible owner, and a deadline.
options.zh: 共同确定一个计划、负责人和截止时间。

options.en: Pause the escalating secure-text exchange.
options.zh: 暂停不断升级的安全短信交流。

correct.en: The sequence first stops the communication channel that is escalating conflict, then uses a synchronous huddle to clarify facts and confirm understanding. The team next assigns a specific plan, owner, and deadline, and only then sends the written closed-loop summary.
correct.zh: 该顺序首先停止正在加剧冲突的沟通渠道，然后通过同步碰头会澄清事实并确认理解。接着团队确定具体计划、负责人和截止时间，最后才发送书面闭环总结。

byChoice.en: Facts and concerns must be stated and checked back before the team can make a reliable plan.
byChoice.zh: 在制定可靠计划之前，必须先陈述事实和问题，并通过复述确认理解。

byChoice.en: A synchronous huddle allows immediate clarification that the text thread could not provide.
byChoice.zh: 同步碰头会能够立即澄清短信交流无法解决的问题。

byChoice.en: Agreement becomes operational only when the plan, responsible person, and deadline are explicit.
byChoice.zh: 只有明确计划、负责人和截止时间，协议才能真正落实。

byChoice.en: Pausing the escalating asynchronous thread prevents further ambiguous or sarcastic messages while the issue is repaired.
byChoice.zh: 暂停不断升级的异步对话，可防止在修复问题时继续出现含糊或讽刺的信息。

byChoice.en: The written summary comes last so it accurately records the agreed plan and closes the communication loop.
byChoice.zh: 书面总结应放在最后，以准确记录已达成的计划并完成沟通闭环。

testTakingStrategy.en: For a communication-repair sequence, stop escalation first, establish mutual understanding next, decide responsibility, and document last.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于沟通修复顺序，应先停止升级，再建立共同理解，然后确定责任，最后记录。

glossary.defZh: 双方不需要同时在线的交流，例如安全短信。
团队为快速澄清情况和协调计划而进行的简短同步讨论。
发送信息、确认理解并验证最终计划的沟通过程。

sourceMetadata: AHRQ TeamSTEPPS, Huddle tool and Check-Back/Closed-Loop Communication tool, https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/team/tools/huddle.html; https://www.ahrq.gov/teamstepps-program/curriculum/communication/tools/loop.html

stem.en: A consulting psychiatrist requests separately maintained psychotherapy session notes from another clinician. No listed HIPAA exception for use or disclosure of psychotherapy notes applies. Complete the statement.
stem.zh: 一位会诊精神科医生向另一位临床人员索取单独保存的心理治疗会谈笔记。目前不适用HIPAA列出的任何心理治疗笔记使用或披露例外。请完成陈述。

clozeStem.en: Disclosure of these separately maintained notes generally requires the client's {{q05_d01}}; the fact that the requesting psychiatrist will use them for {{q05_d02}} does not by itself remove that requirement.
clozeStem.zh: 披露这些单独保存的笔记通常需要患者的{{q05_d01}}；请求方精神科医生将其用于{{q05_d02}}这一事实本身并不能取消该要求。

options.en: no authorization because both people are clinicians
options.zh: 无需授权，因为双方都是临床人员

options.en: verbal permission documented by the requester
options.zh: 由请求方记录的口头许可

options.en: valid written authorization
options.zh: 有效的书面授权

options.en: treatment
options.zh: 治疗

options.en: facility directory management
options.zh: 机构名录管理

options.en: appointment scheduling
options.zh: 预约安排

correct.en: Psychotherapy notes that are maintained separately from the medical record receive special HIPAA protection. With no applicable exception, disclosure requires the client's valid written authorization even when another provider requests the notes for treatment.
correct.zh: 与普通病历分开保存的心理治疗笔记受到HIPAA的特殊保护。在没有适用例外时，即使另一位医护人员为治疗目的请求这些笔记，也需要患者有效的书面授权。

byChoice.en: The correct completion is valid written authorization; verbal permission or the requester's clinician status does not satisfy the rule for separately maintained psychotherapy notes when no exception applies.
byChoice.zh: 正确填空是“有效的书面授权”；在没有例外时，口头许可或请求方也是临床人员，都不能满足单独保存的心理治疗笔记披露规则。

byChoice.en: The correct purpose is treatment. Unlike ordinary treatment records, psychotherapy notes generally still require authorization for this provider-to-provider treatment disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 正确用途是“治疗”。与普通治疗记录不同，医护人员之间为治疗目的披露心理治疗笔记通常仍需要授权。

testTakingStrategy.en: Identify whether the request concerns ordinary mental-health information or separately maintained psychotherapy notes; the latter have a stricter authorization rule.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先判断请求的是普通精神健康信息，还是单独保存的心理治疗笔记；后者适用更严格的授权规则。

glossary.defZh: 由心理健康专业人员记录并与其余病历分开保存的会谈内容笔记。
符合HIPAA要求、由患者签署并允许特定使用或披露的文件。
为患者治疗而在医护提供者之间共享健康信息。

sourceMetadata: HHS Office for Civil Rights, FAQ 558, disclosure of psychotherapy notes through an HIO and the treatment-purpose authorization rule, https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/faq/558/does-hipaa-permit-a-covered-entity-to-disclose-psychotherapy-notes-to-an-hio/index.html

stem.en: A clinic is reviewing its waiting-room sign-in and name-calling process. Highlight the entries and safeguards consistent with HIPAA's incidental-disclosure rule.
stem.zh: 一家门诊正在审查候诊室签到和叫名流程。请标出符合HIPAA附带披露规则的签到内容和保护措施。

segments.en: The sign-in sheet requests only the client's name and arrival time.
segments.zh: 签到表只要求填写患者姓名和到达时间。

segments.en: The sheet omits the diagnosis and detailed reason for the visit.
segments.zh: 签到表不填写诊断和详细就诊原因。

segments.en: The clipboard is positioned and handled to limit casual viewing of earlier entries.
segments.zh: 合理放置和管理签到夹，减少他人随意看到先前条目的机会。

segments.en: Staff call the client's name without announcing clinical details.
segments.zh: 工作人员叫患者姓名，但不宣布临床细节。

segments.en: The sheet asks each client to write the suspected diagnosis beside the name.
segments.zh: 签到表要求每位患者在姓名旁写下疑似诊断。

segments.en: The completed sheet remains fully visible on the counter throughout the day.
segments.zh: 已填写的签到表整天完全暴露在柜台上。

segments.en: Staff announce, ‘Ms. Chen, the diabetes educator is ready for you.’
segments.zh: 工作人员宣布：“陈女士，糖尿病教育员可以接待您了。”

segments.en: The clinic bans all sign-in sheets and all use of client names in the waiting room.
segments.zh: 门诊禁止所有签到表，并禁止在候诊室使用患者姓名。

correct.en: HIPAA permits sign-in sheets and calling a client's name when only limited information is used and reasonable safeguards reduce unnecessary disclosure. Diagnosis and detailed visit information should not be exposed in the waiting room.
correct.zh: HIPAA允许使用签到表和叫患者姓名，前提是只使用有限信息，并采取合理保护措施减少不必要的披露。诊断和详细就诊信息不应在候诊室暴露。

byChoice.en: Name and arrival time are limited identifying information appropriate for a sign-in process.
byChoice.zh: 姓名和到达时间属于签到流程中可使用的有限识别信息。

byChoice.en: Omitting diagnosis and detailed reasons reduces unnecessary disclosure of clinical information.
byChoice.zh: 不填写诊断和详细就诊原因，可减少不必要的临床信息披露。

byChoice.en: Reasonable positioning and handling safeguards limit incidental viewing by others.
byChoice.zh: 合理放置和管理签到表，可以限制他人附带看到信息。

byChoice.en: Calling a name without clinical details is permitted when reasonable safeguards are used.
byChoice.zh: 在采取合理保护措施时，只叫姓名而不宣布临床细节是允许的。

byChoice.en: A suspected diagnosis is more information than the sign-in process needs and should not be displayed.
byChoice.zh: 疑似诊断超出了签到流程所需的信息，不应公开显示。

byChoice.en: Leaving all prior entries openly visible does not use reasonable safeguards.
byChoice.zh: 让所有先前条目持续公开可见，不符合合理保护措施。

byChoice.en: Linking the name to a diabetes service announces a clinical detail that is not needed for calling the client.
byChoice.zh: 把姓名与糖尿病服务联系起来，会宣布叫号所不需要的临床信息。

byChoice.en: HIPAA does not categorically prohibit sign-in sheets or calling names when information is limited and safeguarded.
byChoice.zh: 当信息有限且受到保护时，HIPAA并不一概禁止签到表或叫患者姓名。

testTakingStrategy.en: HIPAA questions often turn on limiting information and using reasonable safeguards, not banning ordinary workflow altogether.
testTakingStrategy.zh: HIPAA题目常考“限制信息并采取合理保护措施”，而不是完全禁止日常工作流程。

glossary.defZh: 在允许的工作过程中、采取合理保护措施后仍可能发生的有限信息暴露。
根据环境降低无关人员接触受保护信息机会的实际措施。
用于记录患者到达的候诊登记工具。

sourceMetadata: HHS Office for Civil Rights, FAQ 199, sign-in sheets and calling client names using limited information and reasonable safeguards, https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/faq/199/may-health-care-providers-use-sign-in-sheets/index.html

segments.zh: 工作人员宣布：“陈女士，糖尿病教育员可以接待您了。”

segments.en: The clinic bans all sign-in sheets and all use of client names in the waiting room.
segments.zh: 门诊禁止所有签到表，并禁止在候诊室使用患者姓名。

correct.en: HIPAA permits sign-in sheets and calling a client's name when only limited information is used and reasonable safeguards reduce unnecessary disclosure. Diagnosis and detailed visit information should not be exposed in the waiting room.
correct.zh: HIPAA允许使用签到表和叫患者姓名，前提是只使用有限信息，并采取合理保护措施减少不必要的披露。诊断和详细就诊信息不应在候诊室暴露。

byChoice.en: Name and arrival time are limited identifying information appropriate for a sign-in process.
byChoice.zh: 姓名和到达时间属于签到流程中可使用的有限识别信息。

byChoice.en: Omitting diagnosis and detailed reasons reduces unnecessary disclosure of clinical information.
byChoice.zh: 不填写诊断和详细就诊原因，可减少不必要的临床信息披露。

byChoice.en: Reasonable positioning and handling safeguards limit incidental viewing by others.
byChoice.zh: 合理放置和管理签到表，可以限制他人附带看到信息。

byChoice.en: Calling a name without clinical details is permitted when reasonable safeguards are used.
byChoice.zh: 在采取合理保护措施时，只叫姓名而不宣布临床细节是允许的。

byChoice.en: A suspected diagnosis is more information than the sign-in process needs and should not be displayed.
byChoice.zh: 疑似诊断超出了签到流程所需的信息，不应公开显示。

byChoice.en: Leaving all prior entries openly visible does not use reasonable safeguards.
byChoice.zh: 让所有先前条目持续公开可见，不符合合理保护措施。

byChoice.en: Linking the name to a diabetes service announces a clinical detail that is not needed for calling the client.
byChoice.zh: 把姓名与糖尿病服务联系起来，会宣布叫号所不需要的临床信息。

byChoice.en: HIPAA does not categorically prohibit sign-in sheets or calling names when information is limited and safeguarded.
byChoice.zh: 当信息有限且受到保护时，HIPAA并不一概禁止签到表或叫患者姓名。

testTakingStrategy.en: HIPAA questions often turn on limiting information and using reasonable safeguards, not banning ordinary workflow altogether.
testTakingStrategy.zh: HIPAA题目常考“限制信息并采取合理保护措施”，而不是完全禁止日常工作流程。

glossary.defZh: 在允许的工作过程中、采取合理保护措施后仍可能发生的有限信息暴露。
根据环境降低无关人员接触受保护信息机会的实际措施。
用于记录患者到达的候诊登记工具。

stem.en: A hospitalist asks whether the hospital may send relevant ordinary medical-record information to the specialist who will treat the same client. The request does not involve separately maintained psychotherapy notes. Complete the statement.
stem.zh: 一位住院医生询问，医院是否可以把相关的普通病历信息发送给将治疗同一患者的专科医生。该请求不涉及单独保存的心理治疗笔记。请完成陈述。

clozeStem.en: HIPAA {{q07_d01}} this provider-to-provider disclosure without the client's authorization, and the minimum-necessary requirement {{q07_d02}} to disclosures or requests between providers for treatment.
clozeStem.zh: HIPAA{{q07_d01}}在没有患者授权的情况下进行这种医护提供者之间的披露；对于医护提供者之间为治疗目的进行的披露或请求，最低必要原则{{q07_d02}}。

options.en: permits only after a separate written authorization
options.zh: 仅在取得单独书面授权后允许

options.en: prohibits
options.zh: 禁止

options.en: permits
options.zh: 允许

options.en: applies only because the specialist is outside the hospital
options.zh: 仅因为专科医生不在本院而适用

options.en: requires limiting every disclosure to one page
options.zh: 要求每次披露限制为一页

options.en: does not apply
options.zh: 不适用

correct.en: HIPAA allows covered providers to disclose relevant protected health information to another provider for treatment without the client's authorization. The minimum-necessary standard does not apply to disclosures or requests between providers for treatment.
correct.zh: HIPAA允许受监管的医护提供者在没有患者授权的情况下，为治疗目的向另一位医护提供者披露相关受保护健康信息。最低必要原则不适用于医护提供者之间为治疗目的进行的披露或请求。

byChoice.en: The correct completion is permits. Ordinary relevant records may be shared for treatment without a separate client authorization; this is distinct from the special rule for psychotherapy notes.
byChoice.zh: 正确填空是“允许”。普通的相关病历可以为治疗目的共享，无需另行取得患者授权；这与心理治疗笔记的特殊规则不同。

byChoice.en: The correct completion is does not apply. The treatment exception concerns provider-to-provider disclosures and requests, not an arbitrary page limit or the specialist's organizational location.
byChoice.zh: 正确填空是“不适用”。治疗例外适用于医护提供者之间的披露和请求，与任意页数限制或专科医生是否属于同一机构无关。

testTakingStrategy.en: First identify the purpose and record type: ordinary information for treatment follows a different rule from separately maintained psychotherapy notes.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 先判断用途和记录类型：为治疗目的共享普通信息，与单独保存的心理治疗笔记适用不同规则。

glossary.defZh: HIPAA保护的、可识别个人身份的健康信息。
在适用时，将使用、披露或请求限制在完成目的所需范围。
为患者提供、协调或管理医疗服务。

stem.en: A ventilator-dependent child with a new tracheostomy is scheduled for a first discharge home tomorrow. One parent has completed routine tracheostomy care, but neither caregiver has successfully managed a simulated obstruction or accidental decannulation. Delivery of backup tracheostomy and ventilation equipment is unconfirmed, and no awake, attentive, trained caregiver is available for overnight coverage. Complete the bow-tie.
stem.zh: 一名依赖呼吸机、刚建立气管切开通道的儿童计划明天首次出院回家。一位家长已完成常规气管切开护理培训，但两位照护者都没有成功处理过模拟的气道阻塞或意外脱管。备用气管切开和通气设备的送达尚未确认，夜间也没有清醒、专注且受过培训的照护者。请完成蝴蝶结题。

condition.en: Unsafe tracheostomy-home transition
condition.zh: 不安全的气管切开居家转衔

condition.en: Ventilator-setting intolerance requiring a new prescription
condition.zh: 无法耐受呼吸机设置，需要新的处方

condition.en: Routine discharge readiness with expected caregiver anxiety
condition.zh: 已具备常规出院条件，仅有预期的照护者焦虑

actions.en: Confirm required backup equipment is delivered and functional and arrange awake, trained caregiver coverage for all required periods
actions.zh: 确认所需备用设备已送达且功能正常，并为所有需要时段安排清醒且受过培训的照护者

actions.en: Delay and revise discharge until intended caregivers successfully demonstrate obstruction and decannulation emergency management
actions.zh: 延迟并修订出院计划，直到预定照护者成功演示阻塞和脱管紧急处理

actions.en: Rely on emergency medical services as the primary response to obstruction or decannulation
actions.zh: 把急救医疗服务作为发生阻塞或脱管时的主要应对方式

actions.en: Proceed because successful routine tracheostomy care proves emergency readiness
actions.zh: 继续出院，因为能完成常规气管切开护理就证明已具备紧急处理能力

actions.en: Send the child home while equipment delivery and nighttime coverage remain pending
actions.zh: 在设备送达和夜间照护仍未落实时让儿童回家

parameters.en: A state-specific guarantee of a fixed number of home-nursing hours
parameters.zh: 由州政策保证固定数量的居家护理小时

parameters.en: Successful caregiver simulation of obstruction and accidental decannulation management
parameters.zh: 照护者成功完成阻塞和意外脱管处理模拟

parameters.en: The exact ventilator settings chosen by the learner
parameters.zh: 由答题者选择的具体呼吸机设置

parameters.en: A lower caregiver-anxiety score without another skills demonstration
parameters.zh: 照护者焦虑评分下降，但未再次演示技能

parameters.en: Verified backup-equipment function and awake trained-caregiver coverage
parameters.zh: 已核实备用设备功能及清醒、受训照护者覆盖

correct.en: The home transition is unsafe because emergency tracheostomy competence, backup equipment, and continuously available awake trained caregiving are not established. Discharge should be delayed or revised until emergency skills and the required home support system are verified.
correct.zh: 该居家转衔不安全，因为尚未确认气管切开紧急处理能力、备用设备以及持续可用的清醒受训照护者。应延迟或修订出院计划，直到紧急技能和所需居家支持系统得到核实。

byChoice.en: Multiple required safety elements for first home transition are missing, making the plan unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 首次居家转衔所需的多个安全要素缺失，因此计划不安全。

byChoice.en: This is not routine anxiety; caregivers have not demonstrated critical emergency skills and required coverage is absent.
byChoice.zh: 这不仅是常规焦虑；照护者尚未证明关键紧急技能，且必要覆盖缺失。

byChoice.en: The scenario does not provide evidence of ventilator-setting intolerance or ask for new settings.
byChoice.zh: 情境没有提供无法耐受呼吸机设置的证据，也没有要求制定新设置。

byChoice.en: Successful simulation is needed before caregivers can be considered prepared for obstruction and decannulation emergencies.
byChoice.zh: 照护者必须成功完成模拟，才能被视为已准备好处理阻塞和脱管紧急情况。

byChoice.en: Backup equipment and awake trained coverage are essential components of a safe home plan.
byChoice.zh: 备用设备和清醒受训照护者覆盖是安全居家计划的必要组成部分。

byChoice.en: Routine care competence does not prove ability to respond to life-threatening obstruction or decannulation.
byChoice.zh: 能完成常规护理并不能证明能够应对危及生命的阻塞或脱管。

byChoice.en: Emergency services cannot replace immediate action by an awake trained caregiver in the home.
byChoice.zh: 急救服务不能替代居家环境中清醒受训照护者的即时处理。

byChoice.en: Unconfirmed equipment and coverage are unresolved discharge hazards, not tasks to defer until after discharge.
byChoice.zh: 设备和照护覆盖未确认是尚未解决的出院风险，不能推迟到出院后处理。

byChoice.en: A successful emergency simulation directly verifies the missing caregiver competency.
byChoice.zh: 成功的紧急模拟可直接核实目前缺失的照护者能力。

byChoice.en: Functioning backup equipment and awake trained coverage verify that the home system can support the child safely.
byChoice.zh: 备用设备功能正常且有清醒受训照护者覆盖，才能证明居家系统可安全支持儿童。

byChoice.en: The item does not depend on a state-specific entitlement or fixed home-nursing allocation.
byChoice.zh: 本题不依赖州级特定权益或固定的居家护理时数。

byChoice.en: Ventilator settings are prescribed clinical parameters and are not the transition-readiness outcome being tested.
byChoice.zh: 呼吸机设置属于处方性临床参数，不是本题要评价的转衔准备结果。

byChoice.en: Reduced anxiety alone does not establish emergency performance competence.
byChoice.zh: 仅焦虑下降并不能证明具备紧急处理能力。

testTakingStrategy.en: For technology-dependent pediatric discharge, distinguish routine-task teaching from demonstrated emergency competence and verified around-the-clock support.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于依赖医疗技术的儿童出院，应区分常规任务培训与经演示验证的紧急能力及全天候支持。

glossary.defZh: 气管切开套管意外脱出气道。
分泌物、位置或其他原因导致气管切开通道受阻。
能够持续观察并立即执行气道紧急处理的照护者。

sourceMetadata: American Thoracic Society, Care of Infants and Children with Tracheostomies, Recommendation 2, Table 2, emergency training competencies, and awake-attentive-trained-caregiver recommendation, https://academic.oup.com/ajrccm/article/211/11/2001/8444168

testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于依赖医疗技术的儿童出院，应区分常规任务培训与经演示验证的紧急能力及全天候支持。

glossary.defZh: 气管切开套管意外脱出气道。
分泌物、位置或其他原因导致气管切开通道受阻。
能够持续观察并立即执行气道紧急处理的照护者。

meta.source: American Thoracic Society, Care of Infants and Children with Tracheostomies, Recommendation 2, Table 2, emergency training competencies, and awake-attentive-trained-caregiver recommendation, https://academic.oup.com/ajrccm/article/211/11/2001/8444168

stem.en: A hospitalized client receives maintenance methadone for opioid use disorder and will leave Friday evening. The listed opioid treatment program (OTP) has not accepted the handoff, the weekend dosing plan is unknown, and the client's last verified hospital dose and administration time have not been transmitted. The client has consented to the facility's direct OTP communication workflow. Complete the bow-tie.
stem.zh: 一位因阿片类药物使用障碍而接受美沙酮维持治疗的住院患者将在周五晚上出院。列出的阿片类药物治疗项目（OTP）尚未接受交接，周末给药计划未知，患者在医院最后一次经核实的剂量和给药时间尚未传送。患者已同意机构与OTP直接沟通的流程。请完成蝴蝶结题。

condition.en: Confirmed duplicate outpatient methadone dosing
condition.zh: 已确认门诊美沙酮重复给药

condition.en: Threatened interruption in medication for opioid use disorder continuity
condition.zh: 阿片类药物使用障碍药物治疗连续性受到威胁

condition.en: Expected completion of methadone therapy at hospital discharge
condition.zh: 美沙酮治疗将在出院时按预期结束

actions.en: Choose a universal restart dose for the OTP to use if the client misses a day
actions.zh: 为OTP选择一个通用的漏服后重新开始剂量

actions.en: Discharge the client with instructions to visit an emergency department if withdrawal begins
actions.zh: 让患者出院，并告知若出现戒断再去急诊科

actions.en: Transmit the verified methadone regimen and the exact last hospital dose and administration time through the approved workflow
actions.zh: 通过获批流程传送经核实的美沙酮方案以及医院最后一次给药的准确剂量和时间

actions.en: Have the hospital independently prescribe an outpatient weekend methadone supply
actions.zh: 由医院独立开具周末门诊美沙酮供应处方

actions.en: Obtain direct OTP acceptance and confirm the Friday-evening or weekend dosing plan
actions.zh: 取得OTP直接接受交接的确认，并确认周五晚间或周末给药计划

parameters.en: A lower pain score after the last hospital dose
parameters.zh: 医院最后一次给药后疼痛评分下降

parameters.en: Confirmed date, time, and location of the next OTP dosing encounter
parameters.zh: 已确认下一次OTP给药的日期、时间和地点

parameters.en: A negative urine drug screen before discharge
parameters.zh: 出院前尿液药物筛查阴性

parameters.en: Use of the same restart dose for every client after any missed dose
parameters.zh: 所有患者漏服后都使用同一个重新开始剂量

parameters.en: No unintended gap between the last hospital dose and the next verified dose
parameters.zh: 医院最后一次给药与下一次核实给药之间没有非预期中断

correct.en: The incomplete OTP handoff threatens an unintended interruption in medication for opioid use disorder. Direct acceptance, a confirmed dosing plan, and transmission of the verified regimen and last-dose information are needed before discharge; continuity is verified by the next dosing encounter and absence of a medication gap.
correct.zh: 未完成的OTP交接会造成阿片类药物使用障碍药物治疗的非预期中断。出院前需要取得直接接受、确认给药计划，并传送经核实的方案和最后一次给药信息；通过下一次给药安排以及没有用药空档来核实连续性。

byChoice.en: The missing acceptance, weekend plan, and last-dose transmission create a clear risk of an unintended treatment gap.
byChoice.zh: 缺少接受确认、周末计划和最后一次给药信息，会明显造成非预期治疗中断风险。

byChoice.en: Maintenance methadone is not expected to end simply because the hospitalization ends.
byChoice.zh: 美沙酮维持治疗不会仅因为住院结束而按预期终止。

byChoice.en: The scenario shows missing coordination, not confirmed duplicate dosing.
byChoice.zh: 情境显示的是协调缺失，而不是已确认重复给药。

byChoice.en: Direct OTP acceptance and a concrete weekend plan establish who will provide the next dose.
byChoice.zh: OTP直接接受并制定具体周末计划，可明确下一剂由谁提供。

byChoice.en: The exact verified regimen and last dose/time are essential for safe continuity and avoiding duplication or gaps.
byChoice.zh: 准确核实的方案和最后一次剂量/时间，对于安全连续治疗以及避免重复或中断至关重要。

byChoice.en: The hospital should not independently create an outpatient methadone supply outside the applicable OTP pathway.
byChoice.zh: 医院不应脱离适用的OTP流程，独立提供门诊美沙酮供应。

byChoice.en: Restart decisions are individualized and cannot be replaced by a universal dose invented for this item.
byChoice.zh: 重新开始剂量需要个体化决定，不能用本题臆造的通用剂量替代。

byChoice.en: Waiting for withdrawal and relying on emergency care fails to complete the planned continuity handoff.
byChoice.zh: 等待出现戒断再依赖急诊护理，并不能完成计划中的连续治疗交接。

byChoice.en: A confirmed next dosing encounter is direct evidence that the receiving program has operationalized the handoff.
byChoice.zh: 确认下一次给药安排，可直接证明接收项目已落实交接。

byChoice.en: The central safety outcome is uninterrupted intended medication continuity.
byChoice.zh: 核心安全结果是预期的药物治疗没有中断。

byChoice.en: A urine test does not establish that the next methadone dose is arranged.
byChoice.zh: 尿液检测不能证明下一次美沙酮给药已经安排。

byChoice.en: Pain response does not verify continuity of opioid-use-disorder treatment after discharge.
byChoice.zh: 疼痛反应不能核实出院后阿片类药物使用障碍治疗的连续性。

byChoice.en: A universal restart-dose rule is unsafe and is not the continuity outcome being monitored.
byChoice.zh: 通用重新开始剂量规则不安全，也不是本题要监测的连续性结果。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge medications that depend on a specialized receiving program, verify acceptance, exact last-dose communication, and the next actual encounter—not merely a referral name.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于依赖专门接收项目的出院用药，应核实接受交接、准确传送最后一次给药信息以及下一次实际就诊，而不仅是列出转诊机构名称。

glossary.defZh: 获准提供和管理美沙酮等阿片类药物使用障碍治疗的项目。

glossary.termZh: 阿片类药物使用障碍药物治疗
glossary.defZh: 使用美沙酮、丁丙诺啡或纳曲酮等药物治疗阿片类药物使用障碍。
确认最近一次药物的准确剂量和给药时间。

stem.en: A capable client wants both adult daughters involved after discharge. Each daughter believes the other is responsible for the evening medication setup and meal check, and repeated gaps have occurred. Highlight the actions that resolve caregiver-role ambiguity and create reliable coverage.
stem.zh: 一位有决策能力的患者希望两位成年女儿都参与出院后的照护。每位女儿都认为另一位负责晚间摆药和查看进餐情况，因此已经多次出现照护空档。请标出能够解决照护角色不清并建立可靠覆盖的行动。

segments.en: Confirm the client's permission, goals, and preferences for involving both daughters.
segments.zh: 确认患者允许两位女儿参与，并了解患者的目标和偏好。

segments.en: Meet with the client and both daughters together to review the recurring gaps.
segments.zh: 与患者和两位女儿共同会面，回顾反复出现的照护空档。

segments.en: Assign an accepted primary owner and backup person for each evening task.
segments.zh: 为每项晚间任务指定各方接受的主要负责人和备用人员。

segments.en: Create one shared schedule or log that requires closed-loop confirmation when a task is completed or handed off.
segments.zh: 建立一个共享日程或记录表，任务完成或交接时必须进行闭环确认。

segments.en: Verify that each daughter understands and can perform the role she accepts.
segments.zh: 核实每位女儿理解并能够完成自己接受的角色。

segments.en: Tell the daughters that the recent gaps occurred because neither one cares enough.
segments.zh: 告诉两位女儿，最近的空档是因为她们都不够关心。

segments.en: Accept the statement, ‘We will both help whenever possible,’ as sufficient coverage.
segments.zh: 把“我们有空都会帮忙”视为足够的照护覆盖。

segments.en: Require the client to choose one daughter and exclude the other from planning.
segments.zh: 要求患者只选择一位女儿，并将另一位排除在计划之外。

correct.en: Reliable shared caregiving requires the capable client's permission and preferences, explicit assignment of each task and backup, one shared closed-loop system, and verification that each person understands and can perform the accepted role. Vague promises and blame do not create coverage.
correct.zh: 可靠的共同照护需要尊重有决策能力患者的许可和偏好，明确每项任务及备用人员，使用统一的闭环系统，并核实每个人理解且能够履行所接受的角色。模糊承诺和责备都不能建立可靠覆盖。

byChoice.en: The capable client remains a full partner and determines who may participate and how.
byChoice.zh: 有决策能力的患者仍是完整合作伙伴，并决定谁可以参与以及如何参与。

byChoice.en: A joint meeting makes the conflicting assumptions visible to everyone who shares responsibility.
byChoice.zh: 共同会面可以让所有承担责任的人都看到彼此冲突的假设。

byChoice.en: A named owner and backup convert a vague shared duty into dependable coverage.
byChoice.zh: 明确主要负责人和备用人员，可把模糊的共同责任变成可靠覆盖。

byChoice.en: A single closed-loop schedule or log shows whether the task was completed or formally handed off.
byChoice.zh: 统一的闭环日程或记录可显示任务是否完成或正式交接。

byChoice.en: Assignment is safe only when the person understands the task and can perform it.
byChoice.zh: 只有在相关人员理解并能完成任务时，角色分配才安全。

byChoice.en: Blame damages collaboration and does not clarify ownership or skill.
byChoice.zh: 责备会破坏合作，也不能澄清责任或能力。

byChoice.en: ‘Whenever possible’ does not identify who is responsible at a specific time and leaves the original gap unresolved.
byChoice.zh: “有空就帮忙”没有说明具体时段由谁负责，原有空档仍未解决。

byChoice.en: The client wants both daughters involved; excluding one is unnecessary and conflicts with the client's preference.
byChoice.zh: 患者希望两位女儿都参与，排除其中一位既无必要，也违背患者偏好。

testTakingStrategy.en: When shared caregiving fails, choose actions that replace assumptions with named ownership, backup coverage, and confirmation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当共同照护出现失败时，应选择用明确负责人、备用覆盖和确认机制取代相互假设的行动。

glossary.defZh: 照护任务的负责人、时间或范围没有明确约定。
主要负责人无法执行任务时明确接替的人。
要求任务完成或交接后得到明确确认的共享计划。

sourceMetadata: AHRQ IDEAL Discharge Planning, patient and family as full partners and attention to goals, preferences, observations, and concerns, https://www.ahrq.gov/patient-safety/patients-families/engagingfamilies/strategy4/index.html; AHRQ Re-Engineered Discharge Toolkit, Tool 3, identifying actual caregivers who share responsibilities and confirming understanding, https://www.ahrq.gov/patient-safety/settings/hospital/red/toolkit/redtool3.html

byChoice.zh: 明确主要负责人和备用人员，可把模糊的共同责任变成可靠覆盖。

byChoice.en: A single closed-loop schedule or log shows whether the task was completed or formally handed off.
byChoice.zh: 统一的闭环日程或记录可显示任务是否完成或正式交接。

byChoice.en: Assignment is safe only when the person understands the task and can perform it.
byChoice.zh: 只有在相关人员理解并能完成任务时，角色分配才安全。

byChoice.en: Blame damages collaboration and does not clarify ownership or skill.
byChoice.zh: 责备会破坏合作，也不能澄清责任或能力。

byChoice.en: ‘Whenever possible’ does not identify who is responsible at a specific time and leaves the original gap unresolved.
byChoice.zh: “有空就帮忙”没有说明具体时段由谁负责，原有空档仍未解决。

byChoice.en: The client wants both daughters involved; excluding one is unnecessary and conflicts with the client's preference.
byChoice.zh: 患者希望两位女儿都参与，排除其中一位既无必要，也违背患者偏好。

testTakingStrategy.en: When shared caregiving fails, choose actions that replace assumptions with named ownership, backup coverage, and confirmation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当共同照护出现失败时，应选择用明确负责人、备用覆盖和确认机制取代相互假设的行动。

glossary.defZh: 照护任务的负责人、时间或范围没有明确约定。
主要负责人无法执行任务时明确接替的人。
要求任务完成或交接后得到明确确认的共享计划。

meta.source: AHRQ IDEAL Discharge Planning, patient and family as full partners and attention to goals, preferences, observations, and concerns, https://www.ahrq.gov/patient-safety/patients-families/engagingfamilies/strategy4/index.html; AHRQ Re-Engineered Discharge Toolkit, Tool 3, identifying actual caregivers who share responsibilities and confirming understanding, https://www.ahrq.gov/patient-safety/settings/hospital/red/toolkit/redtool3.html
stem_disambiguators: capable client wants both daughters involved

stem.en: Before home discharge with a feeding pump, the caregiver says they are afraid and demonstrates several incorrect setup and alarm-response steps. Classify each team response according to whether it supports safe caregiver capacity.
stem.zh: 在使用营养泵出院回家之前，照护者表示害怕，并在设备设置和报警处理演示中出现多处错误。请判断每项团队回应是否有助于建立安全的照护能力。

rows.en: Listen to the caregiver's concerns and ask which steps feel most difficult.
rows.zh: 倾听照护者的担忧，并询问哪些步骤最困难。

rows.en: Demonstrate the setup, then require the caregiver to perform teach-back using the actual pump.
rows.zh: 演示设置过程，然后要求照护者使用实际营养泵进行回示。

rows.en: Retrain the incorrect alarm-response steps and repeat the skills demonstration.
rows.zh: 重新训练错误的报警处理步骤，并重复技能演示。

rows.en: Simplify and adapt written or visual instructions to the caregiver's needs.
rows.zh: 根据照护者需要简化和调整书面或图示说明。

rows.en: Reassess competence and revise the discharge plan if safe performance is not achieved.
rows.zh: 重新评估能力；如果未达到安全操作要求，则修订出院计划。

rows.en: Say, ‘You should know this by now,’ to motivate better performance.
rows.zh: 说“你现在早该会了”，以激励其表现得更好。

rows.en: Document the caregiver as ‘noncompliant’ without another assessment or training attempt.
rows.zh: 在不再次评估或培训的情况下，把照护者记录为“不依从”。

rows.en: Give only the manufacturer's brochure and cancel the hands-on demonstration.
rows.zh: 只提供厂家手册，并取消动手演示。

rows.en: Proceed with discharge because the supply company can answer questions later.
rows.zh: 继续出院，因为供应公司以后可以回答问题。

columns.zh: 有助于建立安全照护能力

columns.en: Does not support safe caregiver capacity
columns.zh: 无助于建立安全照护能力

correct.en: Safe home use requires listening, tailored education, demonstration and teach-back, retraining, and reassessment of actual performance. If competence is not achieved, the plan must change. Shame, labels, passive brochures, or deferred vendor support do not verify safe capacity.
correct.zh: 安全居家使用需要倾听、个体化教育、演示与回示、重新训练以及对实际操作的再评估。如果未达到能力要求，必须改变计划。羞辱、贴标签、只发手册或把问题推迟给供应商，都不能核实安全能力。

byChoice.en: Listening identifies barriers and supports a training plan responsive to the caregiver's concerns.
byChoice.zh: 倾听可识别障碍，并制定回应照护者担忧的培训计划。

byChoice.en: Hands-on teach-back verifies whether the caregiver can perform the setup rather than merely recognize instructions.
byChoice.zh: 动手回示可核实照护者是否真正能完成设置，而不只是看懂说明。

byChoice.en: Incorrect steps require targeted retraining followed by another performance check.
byChoice.zh: 错误步骤需要针对性重新训练，并再次检查实际操作。

byChoice.en: Adapted materials can reduce cognitive, language, literacy, or workflow barriers to safe performance.
byChoice.zh: 调整后的材料可以减少认知、语言、读写或流程障碍，促进安全操作。

byChoice.en: Competence must be reassessed, and an alternative plan is required when safe self-management is not achieved.
byChoice.zh: 必须重新评估能力；如果未达到安全自我管理要求，就需要制定替代计划。

byChoice.en: Shaming increases distress and does not teach or verify the missing skill.
byChoice.zh: 羞辱会增加压力，也不能教授或核实缺失的技能。

byChoice.en: A label without reassessment ignores correctable barriers and provides no evidence of competence.
byChoice.zh: 不重新评估就贴标签，会忽略可纠正的障碍，也不能提供能力证据。

byChoice.en: A brochure alone cannot replace demonstration and teach-back for a hands-on device task.
byChoice.zh: 对于需要动手操作的设备任务，单独一本手册不能替代演示和回示。

byChoice.en: Future access to a supply company does not make an unverified caregiver ready at the time of discharge.
byChoice.zh: 以后能联系供应公司，并不能使当前能力未核实的照护者具备出院准备。

testTakingStrategy.en: For home-device teaching, choose responses that measure actual performance and change the plan when competence is not demonstrated.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于居家设备教学，应选择能够测量实际操作表现，并在能力未被证明时改变计划的回应。

glossary.defZh: 让学习者用自己的语言说明或亲自演示，以确认理解和能力。
照护者能够正确、稳定且安全完成所需任务。
当原定居家自我管理不安全时采用的其他照护安排。

sourceMetadata: AHRQ Re-Engineered Discharge Toolkit, Tool 3a, demonstration/teach-back and creating an alternative plan when understanding is not achieved, https://www.ahrq.gov/patient-safety/settings/hospital/red/toolkit/redtool3a.html; NICE Quality Standard QS24, Quality statement 4, self-management competency for artificial nutrition support, https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/qs24/chapter/quality-statement-4-self-management-of-artificial-nutrition-support

stem.en: A client with diabetic ketoacidosis and repeated vomiting has: pH 7.31, PaCO2 27 mm Hg, HCO3 13 mEq/L, Na 140 mEq/L, and Cl 96 mEq/L. Use only these supplied rules: AG = Na − (Cl + HCO3); normal AG = 12 mEq/L. Delta AG = measured AG − 12. Corrected HCO3 = measured HCO3 + delta AG; supplied normal HCO3 range = 22–26 mEq/L. Expected PaCO2 = 1.5(HCO3) + 8 ± 2 mm Hg. Complete the interpretation.
stem.zh: 一位糖尿病酮症酸中毒并反复呕吐的患者检查结果为：pH 7.31、PaCO2 27 mm Hg、HCO3 13 mEq/L、Na 140 mEq/L、Cl 96 mEq/L。仅使用以下给定规则：AG = Na −（Cl + HCO3）；正常AG = 12 mEq/L。Delta AG = 实测AG − 12。校正HCO3 = 实测HCO3 + delta AG；给定的正常HCO3范围 = 22–26 mEq/L。预期PaCO2 = 1.5(HCO3) + 8 ± 2 mm Hg。请完成判断。

clozeStem.en: The primary disorder is {{q12_d01}}. The measured PaCO2 represents {{q12_d02}}. The corrected HCO3 demonstrates {{q12_d03}}.
clozeStem.zh: 主要紊乱是{{q12_d01}}。实测PaCO2表示{{q12_d02}}。校正HCO3提示{{q12_d03}}。

options.en: normal-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 正常阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒

options.en: high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒

options.en: primary respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 原发性呼吸性碱中毒

options.en: a concurrent respiratory acidosis
options.zh: 并存呼吸性酸中毒

options.en: a concurrent respiratory alkalosis
options.zh: 并存呼吸性碱中毒

options.en: appropriate respiratory compensation
options.zh: 适当的呼吸性代偿

options.en: a concurrent metabolic alkalosis
options.zh: 并存代谢性碱中毒

options.en: a concurrent normal-anion-gap metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 并存正常阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒

options.en: no additional metabolic disorder
options.zh: 没有其他代谢性紊乱

correct.en: AG = 140 − (96 + 13) = 31 mEq/L, confirming high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis. Expected PaCO2 is 1.5(13) + 8 ± 2 = 25.5–29.5 mm Hg; the measured 27 mm Hg is appropriate compensation. Delta AG is 31 − 12 = 19, so corrected HCO3 is 13 + 19 = 32 mEq/L, above the supplied 22–26 range and consistent with concurrent metabolic alkalosis from vomiting.
correct.zh: AG = 140 −（96 + 13）= 31 mEq/L，证实高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒。预期PaCO2为1.5（13）+ 8 ± 2，即25.5–29.5 mm Hg；实测27 mm Hg属于适当代偿。Delta AG = 31 − 12 = 19，因此校正HCO3 = 13 + 19 = 32 mEq/L，高于给定的22–26范围，符合反复呕吐导致的并存代谢性碱中毒。

byChoice.en: The calculated anion gap is 31, which is elevated above the supplied normal value of 12; this identifies a high-anion-gap metabolic acidosis, not a normal-gap disorder or a primary respiratory process.
byChoice.zh: 计算得阴离子间隙为31，高于给定正常值12；因此是高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒，而不是正常间隙紊乱或原发呼吸性过程。

byChoice.en: The expected compensatory range is 25.5–29.5 mm Hg, and the measured PaCO2 of 27 falls within it; values above or below that range would suggest an additional respiratory disorder.
byChoice.zh: 预期代偿范围为25.5–29.5 mm Hg，实测PaCO2 27位于其中；高于或低于该范围才提示额外呼吸性紊乱。

byChoice.en: The corrected HCO3 is 32 mEq/L, above the supplied normal range, indicating an additional metabolic alkalosis rather than no second process or an added normal-gap acidosis.
byChoice.zh: 校正HCO3为32 mEq/L，高于给定正常范围，提示额外的代谢性碱中毒，而不是没有第二种过程或并存正常间隙酸中毒。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use all three calculations: anion gap identifies the primary metabolic process, expected PaCO2 tests compensation, and corrected HCO3 detects a second metabolic disorder.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 同时使用三项计算：阴离子间隙判断主要代谢过程，预期PaCO2检验代偿，校正HCO3发现第二种代谢紊乱。

glossary.defZh: 用钠、氯和碳酸氢根计算的差值，用于分析代谢性酸中毒。
估算代谢性酸中毒时预期呼吸性代偿PaCO2的公式。
把阴离子间隙增量加回实测HCO3，用于寻找并存代谢性紊乱。

sourceMetadata: Merck Manual Professional Edition, Metabolic Acidosis, anion gap, delta gap/corrected bicarbonate, and expected PaCO2 (Winter's formula) discussion, https://www.merckmanuals.com/professional/nephrology/acid-base-regulation-and-disorders/metabolic-acidosis

stem.en: Before wound closure, the final count is short one radiopaque sponge, and an immediate recount does not resolve the discrepancy. The facility sequence is: announce the discrepancy and stop closure; recount and search the field, wound, room, linen, and waste; notify the surgeon that the discrepancy remains unresolved and complete a methodical wound examination; obtain intraoperative imaging if still unresolved; document the discrepancy and confirmed resolution before the client leaves the operating room. Place the actions in order.

options.en: Recount and search the surgical field, wound, room, linen, and waste.
options.zh: 重新清点并搜索术野、伤口、房间、布类和废弃物。

options.en: Notify the surgeon that the discrepancy remains unresolved and complete a methodical wound examination.
options.zh: 通知外科医生差异仍未解决，并进行系统性伤口检查。

options.en: Obtain intraoperative imaging if the sponge remains unaccounted for.
options.zh: 如果海绵仍未找到，则进行术中影像检查。

options.en: Announce the count discrepancy and stop wound closure.
options.zh: 宣布清点差异并停止关闭切口。

options.en: Document the discrepancy and the confirmed resolution before the client leaves the operating room.
options.zh: 在患者离开手术室前，记录清点差异和已确认的解决结果。

correct.en: An unresolved incorrect count triggers an immediate surgical stop. The team then performs a structured recount and search, followed by a methodical wound examination. If the item is still missing, intraoperative imaging is obtained. The client does not leave the operating room until the discrepancy and verified resolution are documented.
correct.zh: 清点错误未解决时，应立即执行手术停止。随后团队进行结构化复点和搜索，再进行系统性伤口检查。如果物品仍然缺失，则进行术中影像检查。在差异和核实后的解决结果被记录之前，患者不能离开手术室。

byChoice.en: Once the recount and environmental search fail, the surgeon performs a deliberate wound examination for the missing item.
byChoice.zh: 复点和环境搜索失败后，由外科医生对伤口进行有计划的检查以寻找缺失物。

byChoice.en: Stopping closure preserves the opportunity to locate and remove a retained item before the wound is closed.
byChoice.zh: 停止关闭切口可保留在切口关闭前找到并取出遗留物的机会。

byChoice.en: Documentation comes after the discrepancy has been reconciled and before the client leaves the operating room.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在差异得到核实解决后、患者离开手术室前完成。

byChoice.en: The defined search covers the common locations where a missing sponge may be found and follows the stop.
byChoice.zh: 规定的搜索范围涵盖缺失海绵可能出现的常见位置，应在停止关闭后进行。

byChoice.en: Imaging is the next escalation when the radiopaque sponge remains unaccounted for after the methodical search and examination.
byChoice.zh: 系统搜索和检查后仍找不到带显影标记的海绵时，下一步应升级为影像检查。

testTakingStrategy.en: For an incorrect surgical count, preserve the search opportunity first, escalate from recount to examination to imaging, and document only after resolution is verified.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于手术清点错误，应先保留搜索机会，再从复点升级到伤口检查和影像检查，并在核实解决后记录。

glossary.termZh: 带显影标记的手术海绵
glossary.defZh: 含有可在影像检查中识别标记的手术海绵。
实际清点数与预期数不一致。
手术后意外留在患者体内的器械或材料。

stem.en: During a home peritoneal-dialysis exchange, the transfer set disconnects proximal to an open clamp and the open system is exposed. The client reconnects it and calls immediately; there is no abdominal pain and the effluent is currently clear. The PD program defines this event as wet contamination and directs the client to stop further use and close the system, contact the PD team for transfer-set management and prescribed prophylaxis, and complete the program's symptom and follow-up checks. Complete the bow-tie.
stem.zh: 在居家腹膜透析换液过程中，转接管在开放夹的近端脱开，开放系统暴露。患者重新连接后立即来电；目前没有腹痛，流出液清澈。腹膜透析项目将此事件定义为湿性污染，并指示患者停止继续使用并关闭系统，联系腹膜透析团队处理转接管和实施规定的预防措施，同时完成项目规定的症状监测和随访。请完成蝴蝶结题。

condition.en: Dry contamination with no connection to the open fluid pathway
condition.zh: 未接触开放液路的干性污染

condition.en: Wet peritoneal-dialysis system contamination with peritonitis risk
condition.zh: 腹膜透析系统湿性污染并有腹膜炎风险

condition.en: Dialysis disequilibrium syndrome
condition.zh: 透析失衡综合征

actions.en: Flush several bags through the system before notifying the PD team
actions.zh: 在通知腹膜透析团队前，先用数袋透析液冲洗系统

actions.en: Continue exchanges because the effluent is clear and the client has no symptoms
actions.zh: 因为流出液清澈且患者无症状，继续换液

actions.en: Contact the PD team immediately for transfer-set management and the program's prescribed prophylaxis pathway
actions.zh: 立即联系腹膜透析团队，处理转接管并执行项目规定的预防流程

actions.en: Select an antibiotic, dose, and duration without using the program pathway
actions.zh: 不按照项目流程，自行选择抗生素、剂量和疗程

actions.en: Close or clamp the system and stop further exchanges through the exposed connection
actions.zh: 关闭或夹闭系统，并停止通过暴露连接继续换液

parameters.en: Cloudy effluent or new abdominal pain
parameters.zh: 流出液浑浊或新出现腹痛

parameters.en: A single normal blood pressure reading
parameters.zh: 单次正常血压读数

parameters.en: Completion of the PD program's transfer-set, prophylaxis, and follow-up plan
parameters.zh: 完成腹膜透析项目规定的转接管处理、预防措施和随访计划

parameters.en: Return of appetite before the next exchange
parameters.zh: 下次换液前食欲恢复

parameters.en: A fixed antibiotic duration chosen by the learner
parameters.zh: 由答题者选择的固定抗生素疗程

correct.en: Exposure of an open PD fluid pathway proximal to an open clamp is wet contamination and carries peritonitis risk even before symptoms develop. The client should stop use, secure the system, and follow the PD team's transfer-set and prophylaxis pathway. Monitoring focuses on early peritonitis symptoms and completion of the program-directed follow-up.
correct.zh: 开放夹近端的腹膜透析开放液路发生暴露属于湿性污染，即使尚未出现症状，也有腹膜炎风险。患者应停止使用并保护系统，按照腹膜透析团队的转接管处理和预防流程执行。监测重点是早期腹膜炎症状以及是否完成项目规定的随访。

byChoice.en: The open fluid pathway was exposed proximal to an open clamp, meeting the stem's definition of wet contamination.
byChoice.zh: 开放夹近端的开放液路发生暴露，符合题干给出的湿性污染定义。

byChoice.en: Dry contamination does not involve the open fluid pathway described in this event.
byChoice.zh: 干性污染不涉及本事件所描述的开放液路。

byChoice.en: Dialysis disequilibrium is a different complication and is not caused by an exposed PD connection.
byChoice.zh: 透析失衡是另一种并发症，并非由腹膜透析连接暴露引起。

byChoice.en: Stopping use and closing the system prevents additional exposure through the contaminated connection.
byChoice.zh: 停止使用并关闭系统，可防止通过受污染连接进一步暴露。

byChoice.en: The PD team directs transfer-set management and prophylaxis after wet contamination.
byChoice.zh: 湿性污染后，应由腹膜透析团队指导转接管处理和预防措施。

byChoice.en: Absence of current symptoms does not eliminate the peritonitis risk created by wet contamination.
byChoice.zh: 目前没有症状并不能消除湿性污染造成的腹膜炎风险。

byChoice.en: Flushing before securing the system and contacting the team may extend use of the contaminated pathway.
byChoice.zh: 在保护系统并联系团队前自行冲洗，可能延长对受污染液路的使用。

byChoice.en: The item intentionally defers drug selection, dose, and duration to the prescribed program pathway.
byChoice.zh: 本题明确把药物选择、剂量和疗程交由项目规定流程决定。

byChoice.en: Cloudy effluent and abdominal pain are key clinical findings that can signal PD-associated peritonitis.
byChoice.zh: 流出液浑浊和腹痛是提示腹膜透析相关腹膜炎的重要发现。

byChoice.en: Completion of the directed transfer-set, prophylaxis, and follow-up plan verifies management of the contamination event.
byChoice.zh: 完成规定的转接管处理、预防和随访计划，可核实该污染事件已得到管理。

byChoice.en: A normal blood pressure does not rule out evolving peritonitis or confirm completion of contamination management.
byChoice.zh: 正常血压不能排除正在发展的腹膜炎，也不能确认污染处理已完成。

byChoice.en: Appetite is nonspecific and does not replace symptom monitoring or program follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 食欲缺乏特异性，不能替代症状监测或项目随访。

byChoice.en: The learner should not invent a fixed prophylactic regimen; the program pathway determines it.
byChoice.zh: 答题者不应臆造固定预防方案；具体方案由项目流程决定。

testTakingStrategy.en: In a contamination item, use the stated open-versus-closed pathway definition, act before symptoms appear, and avoid inventing an antimicrobial regimen.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在污染题中，应使用题干给出的开放/关闭液路定义，在症状出现前采取行动，并避免臆造抗菌药方案。

glossary.defZh: 污染接触到开放的腹膜透析液路，使微生物可能进入腹腔。
连接腹膜透析导管与换液系统的部件。
腹膜透析后从腹腔排出的透析液。

sourceMetadata: International Society for Peritoneal Dialysis, Peritonitis guideline recommendations: 2022 update, dry-versus-wet contamination and prophylaxis discussion, https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/08968608221080586

stem.en: Thick meconium is newly noted during labor. The fetal heart tracing is currently normal, and maternal observations are stable. Highlight the actions consistent with the supplied guideline for meconium in labor.
stem.zh: 产程中刚发现浓稠胎粪。当前胎心监护正常，产妇观察结果稳定。请标出符合所给产程胎粪指南的行动。

segments.en: Characterize and document the meconium finding.
segments.zh: 描述并记录胎粪情况。

segments.en: Complete a full maternal and fetal risk assessment.
segments.zh: 完成全面的产妇和胎儿风险评估。

segments.en: Explain that meconium can increase risk and discuss continuous cardiotocography (CTG) monitoring.
segments.zh: 说明胎粪可能增加风险，并讨论连续胎心宫缩监护（CTG）。

segments.en: Support the woman's informed choice after the monitoring options are discussed.
segments.zh: 在讨论监护选项后，支持产妇作出知情选择。

segments.en: Continue reassessing maternal observations, the fetal tracing, and other risk factors.
segments.zh: 继续重新评估产妇观察结果、胎心监护以及其他风险因素。

segments.en: Declare an automatic emergency cesarean birth solely because thick meconium is present.
segments.zh: 仅因出现浓稠胎粪就宣布必须紧急剖宫产。

segments.en: Continue the prior monitoring plan without discussing the new meconium finding or CTG option.
segments.zh: 不讨论新出现的胎粪或连续CTG选项，直接维持原监护计划。

segments.en: Ignore any later fetal-tracing change because the tracing is normal now.
segments.zh: 因为当前胎心监护正常，所以忽略以后出现的任何监护变化。

correct.en: New meconium should be characterized and incorporated into a full maternal-fetal risk assessment. The woman should receive an explanation of the increased risk and a discussion of continuous CTG, retain informed choice, and continue to be reassessed. Meconium alone does not mandate emergency cesarean birth.
correct.zh: 新出现的胎粪应被描述，并纳入全面的母胎风险评估。应向产妇说明风险增加并讨论连续CTG，同时保留其知情选择，并持续重新评估。仅有胎粪并不自动要求紧急剖宫产。

byChoice.en: The appearance and significance of the meconium should be recorded as a new intrapartum finding.
byChoice.zh: 应把胎粪的特征和意义记录为新的产程发现。

byChoice.en: Management depends on the full maternal-fetal picture, not the meconium finding in isolation.
byChoice.zh: 处理取决于完整的母胎情况，而不是孤立看待胎粪。

byChoice.en: The guideline calls for explaining the increased risk and discussing continuous CTG monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 指南要求说明风险增加，并讨论连续CTG监护。

byChoice.en: After receiving relevant information, the woman remains involved in the monitoring decision.
byChoice.zh: 获得相关信息后，产妇仍应参与监护决定。

byChoice.en: The tracing and other risk factors can change, so ongoing reassessment is required.
byChoice.zh: 胎心监护和其他风险因素可能变化，因此需要持续重新评估。

byChoice.en: Meconium raises concern but does not by itself establish an indication for automatic emergency cesarean birth.
byChoice.zh: 胎粪会增加关注，但本身并不能构成自动紧急剖宫产的指征。

byChoice.en: The new finding should change the risk discussion and prompt consideration of continuous CTG.
byChoice.zh: 这一新发现应改变风险讨论，并促使考虑连续CTG。

byChoice.en: A currently normal tracing does not justify ignoring a later change.
byChoice.zh: 当前监护正常并不能成为忽略后续变化的理由。

testTakingStrategy.en: A new intrapartum risk factor usually calls for assessment, explanation, shared monitoring decisions, and reassessment—not an automatic operative response.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 产程中新出现的风险因素通常需要评估、解释、共同决定监护方式和重新评估，而不是自动采取手术处理。

glossary.defZh: 胎儿在出生前或产程中排出的首次肠内容物。
连续记录胎心率和子宫收缩的监护方法。
在了解相关风险、获益和选项后作出的自主选择。

stem.en: The hospital oxygen-pipeline pressure falls abruptly while several clients depend on high-flow or ventilator oxygen. The facility oxygen utility-failure plan and incident command are activated. Complete the bow-tie without changing any client's prescribed oxygen setting.
stem.zh: 医院氧气管道压力突然下降，而多名患者依赖高流量氧疗或呼吸机供氧。机构已启动氧气公用系统故障计划和事件指挥系统。请完成蝴蝶结题，不要改变任何患者的处方氧疗设置。

condition.en: Isolated pulse-oximeter equipment failure
condition.zh: 单一脉搏血氧仪设备故障

condition.en: Oxygen utility failure threatening oxygen-dependent clients
condition.zh: 威胁依赖氧气患者的氧气公用系统故障

condition.en: Routine reduction in hospital oxygen demand
condition.zh: 医院氧气需求常规下降

actions.en: Use incident command to coordinate facilities and vendor response and implement the plan's oxygen-conservation priorities
actions.zh: 通过事件指挥协调设施和供应商响应，并执行计划中的氧气节约优先级

actions.en: Switch affected clients to verified backup or portable oxygen sources while preserving prescribed support
actions.zh: 在保持处方支持的同时，将受影响患者切换到经核实的备用或便携式氧源

actions.en: Wait for pipeline pressure to recover before moving clients to backup sources
actions.zh: 等待管道压力恢复后再把患者转到备用氧源

actions.en: Evacuate the entire hospital before checking available backup capacity
actions.zh: 在检查备用容量前先疏散整个医院

actions.en: Independently lower every client's oxygen prescription to conserve cylinders
actions.zh: 为节约氧气瓶，自行降低所有患者的氧疗处方

parameters.en: Cylinder inventory and current burn rate
parameters.zh: 氧气瓶库存和当前消耗速率

parameters.en: Cafeteria meal production
parameters.zh: 食堂餐食生产情况

parameters.en: The number of routine outpatient appointments
parameters.zh: 常规门诊预约数量

parameters.en: Client oxygenation and function of each backup oxygen source
parameters.zh: 患者氧合情况以及每个备用氧源的功能

parameters.en: A new oxygen prescription selected by the learner
parameters.zh: 由答题者选择的新氧疗处方

correct.en: Abrupt pipeline pressure loss is an oxygen utility failure that immediately threatens clients dependent on high-flow or ventilator oxygen. The response is to maintain prescribed support using verified backup sources and coordinate repair, supply, and conservation through incident command. Monitoring must track both clinical oxygenation and the remaining backup supply's function and burn rate.
correct.zh: 管道压力突然下降属于氧气公用系统故障，会立即威胁依赖高流量氧疗或呼吸机氧气的患者。应使用经核实的备用氧源维持处方支持，并通过事件指挥协调维修、供应和节约措施。监测必须同时关注患者氧合、备用氧源功能以及剩余供应的消耗速率。

byChoice.en: The shared pipeline pressure loss affecting several oxygen-dependent clients identifies a utility failure.
byChoice.zh: 共同管道压力下降并影响多名依赖氧气的患者，说明是公用系统故障。

byChoice.en: A pulse-oximeter problem would not explain abrupt hospital pipeline pressure loss.
byChoice.zh: 脉搏血氧仪故障不能解释医院氧气管道压力突然下降。

byChoice.en: The event is an unplanned loss of supply pressure, not a routine demand change.
byChoice.zh: 该事件是非计划性的供应压力丧失，而不是常规需求变化。

byChoice.en: Verified backup or portable sources maintain life-supporting oxygen while the pipeline is unreliable.
byChoice.zh: 在管道不可靠时，经核实的备用或便携式氧源可维持生命支持性供氧。

byChoice.en: Incident command coordinates technical response, resupply, and conservation across departments and external partners.
byChoice.zh: 事件指挥系统可在各部门和外部合作方之间协调技术响应、补给和节约措施。

byChoice.en: Changing prescribed oxygen support requires clinical authorization and is not the learner's conservation decision.
byChoice.zh: 改变处方氧疗支持需要临床授权，不应由答题者自行决定以节约氧气。

byChoice.en: Clients dependent on oxygen need an immediate backup source rather than waiting for uncertain recovery.
byChoice.zh: 依赖氧气的患者需要立即获得备用氧源，不能等待不确定的恢复。

byChoice.en: Evacuation may become necessary, but the immediate plan first protects clients and assesses coordinated backup capacity.
byChoice.zh: 以后可能需要疏散，但当前计划首先保护患者并协调评估备用容量。

byChoice.en: Clinical oxygenation and backup-source performance confirm that the substituted supply is actually supporting each client.
byChoice.zh: 患者氧合和备用氧源性能可确认替代供应确实在支持每位患者。

byChoice.en: Inventory and burn rate determine how long the backup supply can sustain current demand and when resupply is needed.
byChoice.zh: 库存和消耗速率决定备用供应能够维持多久以及何时需要补给。

byChoice.en: Meal production does not measure the oxygen system response.
byChoice.zh: 餐食生产不能衡量氧气系统应急响应。

byChoice.en: Routine appointment volume is not a priority measure of immediate oxygen supply safety.
byChoice.zh: 常规预约数量不是衡量当前氧气供应安全的优先指标。

byChoice.en: The question explicitly preserves prescribed oxygen settings; the learner is not choosing a new prescription.
byChoice.zh: 题目明确要求维持处方氧疗设置；答题者不是在选择新处方。

testTakingStrategy.en: In a utility failure, protect dependent clients with verified backup capacity, use incident command for system coordination, and track supply depletion as well as clinical status.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在公用系统故障中，应使用经核实的备用容量保护依赖患者，通过事件指挥协调系统响应，并同时追踪供应消耗和临床状态。

glossary.defZh: 医院中央氧气供应或管道系统无法维持所需功能。
在紧急事件中统一协调人员、资源、沟通和决策的管理结构。
氧气瓶库存按当前使用速度减少的速率。

sourceMetadata: ASPR TRACIE, Utility Failures in Health Care Tip Sheet: Oxygen, pressure loss, backup supply, conservation, partner coordination, inventory, and burn-rate monitoring, https://files.asprtracie.hhs.gov/documents/utility-failure-tip-sheet-oxygen.pdf

stem.en: A nurse wearing artificial fingernail extensions is assigned direct care in the ICU. The facility policy states that artificial extensions are not worn for direct contact with high-risk ICU or operating-room patients and that natural nail tips are kept no longer than 1/4 inch (0.64 cm). Highlight the finding and corrective actions supported by the policy and CDC guidance.
stem.zh: 一名戴有人工指甲延长物的护士被安排在ICU直接照护患者。机构政策规定：与高风险ICU或手术室患者直接接触时不得佩戴人工指甲延长物，自然指甲尖端不得超过1/4英寸（0.64厘米）。请标出符合该政策和CDC指南的发现及纠正行动。

segments.en: Artificial fingernail extensions are present during an assignment involving direct contact with high-risk ICU patients.
segments.zh: 在直接接触高风险ICU患者的工作安排中，护士佩戴了人工指甲延长物。

segments.en: Remove the artificial extensions before providing this direct care or arrange a compliant assignment until they are removed.
segments.zh: 在提供此类直接护理前去除人工指甲延长物，或在去除前安排符合政策的工作。

segments.en: Follow the facility hand-hygiene and nail policy.
segments.zh: 遵守机构的手卫生和指甲政策。

segments.en: Maintain natural nail tips at or below the stated 1/4-inch limit.
segments.zh: 自然指甲尖端保持在规定的1/4英寸以内。

segments.en: Perform hand hygiene at the indicated moments before and after patient contact.
segments.zh: 在患者接触前后等规定时机执行手卫生。

segments.en: Keep the extensions because wearing gloves replaces the need to follow the nail rule.
segments.zh: 保留人工延长指甲，因为戴手套可以代替遵守指甲规定。

segments.en: Scrub the artificial extensions for extra time and continue the ICU assignment.
segments.zh: 延长刷洗人工指甲的时间，然后继续ICU工作。

segments.en: State that all intact nail polish is universally prohibited in every clinical setting.
segments.zh: 宣称所有完整无损的指甲油在任何临床环境中都一律禁止。

correct.en: Artificial fingernail extensions are not appropriate for direct contact with high-risk ICU or operating-room patients. The nurse should comply with the facility nail policy, keep natural nails within the stated length, and perform indicated hand hygiene. Gloves or longer scrubbing do not replace the restriction, and the cited rule does not establish a universal ban on intact nail polish.
correct.zh: 与高风险ICU或手术室患者直接接触时，不应佩戴人工指甲延长物。护士应遵守机构指甲政策，把自然指甲保持在规定长度内，并在规定时机执行手卫生。手套或延长刷洗时间不能替代该限制；所引用规则也没有规定完整无损的指甲油在所有环境中一律禁止。

byChoice.en: This is the policy violation: artificial extensions are present during direct high-risk ICU care.
byChoice.zh: 这就是政策违规点：在高风险ICU直接护理时佩戴人工指甲延长物。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not provide the restricted direct care while the extensions remain in place.
byChoice.zh: 人工延长指甲未去除前，护士不应继续提供受限制的直接护理。

byChoice.en: Facility policy operationalizes the CDC-supported fingernail and hand-hygiene safety practices.
byChoice.zh: 机构政策把CDC支持的指甲和手卫生安全做法落实到实际工作中。

byChoice.en: The stem supplies the accepted natural-nail length limit that should be followed.
byChoice.zh: 题干给出了应遵守的自然指甲长度上限。

byChoice.en: Appropriate nail care supplements but does not replace hand hygiene at required moments.
byChoice.zh: 适当的指甲管理是补充措施，不能替代规定时机的手卫生。

byChoice.en: Gloves do not cancel the fingernail-extension restriction or the need for hand hygiene.
byChoice.zh: 手套不能取消人工指甲限制，也不能取消手卫生要求。

byChoice.en: Extra scrubbing does not make artificial extensions acceptable for direct high-risk ICU care.
byChoice.zh: 延长刷洗时间并不能使人工指甲适用于高风险ICU直接护理。

byChoice.en: The cited guidance addresses artificial extensions and nail length; it does not establish a universal prohibition on intact polish.
byChoice.zh: 所引指南针对人工延长指甲和指甲长度，并未规定完整指甲油在所有环境中一律禁止。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use the exact population and rule in the stem: high-risk direct care triggers the artificial-extension restriction, while unrelated universal claims are distractors.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 使用题干中的具体人群和规则：高风险直接护理触发人工指甲限制，与此无关的一概而论是干扰项。

glossary.defZh: 粘贴或塑形在自然指甲上的人工延长材料。
感染后果严重或对病原体特别易感的患者。
按规定使用肥皂和水或含酒精手消毒剂清洁双手。

stem.en: A nurse wearing artificial fingernail extensions is assigned direct care in the ICU. category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: For each reusable ultrasound-probe use, select the minimum required reprocessing level after use. Follow the probe manufacturer's instructions. Cleaning occurs before disinfection or sterilization. A probe cover reduces contamination but does not replace contact-based reprocessing.
stem.zh: 对于每种可重复使用的超声探头用途，请选择使用后的最低再处理级别。遵循探头制造商说明。清洁应在消毒或灭菌之前进行。探头保护套可减少污染，但不能替代根据接触类型要求的再处理。

rows.en: The probe contacted only intact skin.
rows.zh: 探头只接触完整皮肤。

rows.en: The probe contacted a mucous membrane during a transvaginal examination.
rows.zh: 探头在经阴道检查中接触黏膜。

rows.en: The probe contacted nonintact skin.
rows.zh: 探头接触非完整皮肤。

rows.en: The probe entered sterile tissue during an invasive procedure.
rows.zh: 探头在侵入性操作中进入无菌组织。

rows.en: An intact single-use cover was used while the probe contacted a mucous membrane.
rows.zh: 探头接触黏膜时使用了完整的一次性保护套。

columns.en: Cleaning plus at least high-level disinfection
columns.zh: 清洁加至少高水平消毒

correct.en: Reusable probes are classified by the tissue contacted. Intact-skin contact requires cleaning and low-level disinfection. Mucous-membrane or nonintact-skin contact requires cleaning and at least high-level disinfection. Entry into sterile tissue requires sterilization. A cover does not lower the required level.
correct.zh: 可重复使用探头应根据接触组织分类。接触完整皮肤需要清洁和低水平消毒；接触黏膜或非完整皮肤需要清洁和至少高水平消毒；进入无菌组织需要灭菌。保护套不会降低所需再处理级别。

byChoice.en: A probe contacting only intact skin is noncritical and requires cleaning plus low-level disinfection according to manufacturer instructions.
byChoice.zh: 只接触完整皮肤的探头属于非关键器械，应按制造商说明进行清洁加低水平消毒。

byChoice.en: Mucous-membrane contact makes the probe semicritical and requires cleaning plus at least high-level disinfection.
byChoice.zh: 接触黏膜使探头属于半关键器械，需要清洁加至少高水平消毒。

byChoice.en: Contact with nonintact skin also requires at least high-level disinfection after cleaning.
byChoice.zh: 接触非完整皮肤同样需要在清洁后进行至少高水平消毒。

byChoice.en: A device entering sterile tissue is critical and requires sterilization.
byChoice.zh: 进入无菌组织的器械属于关键器械，需要灭菌。

byChoice.en: A cover reduces contamination but does not replace the high-level reprocessing required after mucous-membrane contact.
byChoice.zh: 保护套可减少污染，但不能替代黏膜接触后所需的高水平再处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Match the reprocessing level to the highest-risk tissue contacted, and do not let a probe cover downgrade the classification.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 根据接触的最高风险组织匹配再处理级别，不要因使用探头保护套而降低分类。

glossary.defZh: 用于非关键器械、可灭活多数常见微生物的消毒级别。
用于半关键器械、可灭活除大量细菌芽孢外多数微生物的消毒级别。
消除包括细菌芽孢在内所有微生物生命形式的过程。
